title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on spec.skill.md (attempt 1)
description: patch_file returned: error applying hunk #1. All context lines appear in the file — check that the removed lines (-) exactly match the file content. Recovery via write_file succeeded.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails when removed lines contain {{run_id}} template variables. Add a unit test covering patch_file on skill files with double-brace syntax.

title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on spec.skill.md (attempt 2)
description: Second patch_file attempt also failed with the same error. The write_file fallback completed the change successfully, but two tool errors were recorded.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file template-variable handling and add regression test; prevent repeated failures from inflating tool error counts.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read for large start_run output
description: Used Read (Claude Code native) to read the start_run output that exceeded token limits and was saved to a Claude Code internal path. No moeb equivalent exists.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to support chunked or paginated output, or add a moeb tool for reading oversized tool-result files.

title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch for deferred schema loading
description: Used ToolSearch (Claude Code native) to load deferred moeb MCP tool schemas. No moeb equivalent exists for this bootstrap operation.
proposed_resolution: Ensure moeb MCP tool schemas are non-deferred so ToolSearch is not needed during run sessions.

title: patch_file fails with template variables in removed lines
description: patch_file failed twice when the removed line contained {{run_id}}. Context lines matched but removed lines did not — likely a preprocessing or encoding issue with double-brace sequences. write_file fallback was required. This will recur on any run patching skill files.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file.rs for any {{}} preprocessing. Add a unit test for patching files containing template variable syntax. Fix root cause so patch_file is reliable on skill markdown files.
